firstPartyChecks.observation: Official municipal GeoCascavel page describes integration with the municipality cadastral base.
Municipal IPC directs users to GeoCascavel to locate a lot and produce a preliminary consultation.
First-party portal shows cadastral dashboard and login controls; a rendered dashboard is not a parcel feature response.
First-party Cascavel group lists text, line and raster sublayers; no parcel polygon sublayer in this group.

firstPartyCache.observation: ArcGIS group id 70 lists text, line and raster sublayers, with no polygon geometry type.
ArcGIS layer 3845 is esriGeometryPolyline in EPSG:31982, not a parcel polygon.

custody.assessment: Municipal cadastral portal custody is grounded. The inspected ArcGIS layer is linework; the portal has no independently verified anonymous native-ID polygon response.

scopeCaveat: No verified public native-ID parcel polygon response. Access errors, login controls or an unavailable viewer do not establish citywide cadastral absence.
